name: Unofficial NEET Patches
author: pawbeans
description: Fixes for bugs in the game itself: saves that fail (a dead house spider, a fuse left over from loading, any single broken object), put-out fires that come back after loading, story events that break when a character is gone or repeat after an error, status effects that freeze, stick or depend on the frame rate, frame rate and vsync settings that don't stick, and promoted cards losing their stats. Every fix can be switched off on its own.
